notes: The Chandler voice is genuinely well-executed — the wet trout simile, the parking lot image, the rain pooling in cracked sidewalks all land — but the self-aware meta-commentary ('I'm aware this pitch reads like every other pitch') tips into postmodern irony that Chandler never indulged, and the overall effect is too literary and self-undermining to function as a real business email anyone would send.
